scope: SP-80 only; evaluate required bundles A-F and build only after every prerequisite gate passes

decisionPolicy.passRule: Exact equality to the executable gate predicate is required for every direct component. An any-of backend/inner-proof group requires at least one component passing all eight gates.

evidenceBoundary.authority: Only hash-pinned local status, manifest, and result records listed in manifest.json are inputs.
evidenceBoundary.statusPrecedence: A PASS from a narrower smoke/build/control does not override a blocked integration or finalist status.
evidenceBoundary.sourceBindingMeaning: A bundle needs deployment-ready proof-system/deployment identity binding; source pins alone are insufficient.
evidenceBoundary.measurements: SP-80 performs no benchmark and makes no new metric claim. Existing component measurements retain their original labels.
evidenceBoundary.prototype: No note, proof, verifier, pool, payment, or state code is implemented in this package because eligible count is zero.

bundleInterpretation.A: The direct-FRI path requires promoted compression, implemented AIR, reviewed transcript, hiding FRI, and common integration gates.
bundleInterpretation.B: The HVZK-WHIR path also requires the exact PQTC relation and a matching modular EVM verifier; the upstream smoke is not that path.
bundleInterpretation.C: The Spartan path requires an implemented repeated structured relation and full EVM Spartan/HVZK verification; standalone WHIR is not sufficient.
bundleInterpretation.D: Best hiding inner proof is an any-of group, but an alternative qualifies only by passing all eight gates before recursion is considered.
bundleInterpretation.E: The plan explicitly conditions a full build on SP-62 passing; Flock is STOP and VEIL PoCs are non-PQTC controls.
bundleInterpretation.F: The fallback requires a security-qualified exact-PQTC proof that intrinsically needs two calls plus full-path SP-72 binding; the state-only harness cannot substitute.
